rule: Wind is paid for by moving: running earns Slipstream pips, and every wind skill spends (or earns) pips for its real effect.

skills.name: Cutting Gust
skills.summary: A short gust that passes through everything in its line. Spends up to 3 pips for +15 each - weak from a standstill.
skills.verb_fit: Lash is "air that strikes and cuts": a thin edge of air through everything in the line.

good_modifiers.word: Lifting Gust: throws light enemies Aloft

bad_modifiers.why: it already passes through everything; falls back to a little power
a gust has nothing that lasts; falls back
its own opposite: cushioned air has no edge, and it has no wind-up to shorten: falls back

skills.name: Crosscut
skills.summary: One enemy within 7 m: you cut through and stop behind it. Always a hit from behind. Spends every pip for +10% each.
skills.verb_fit: Lash as a blade: you are the edge that cuts through and out the other side.

good_modifiers.word: Held Cut: store the cut for a harder one
Rising Cut: cuts them up into the air

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a cushioned cut. Maths lets it act (shorter recovery); the word is nonsense
nothing lasts; falls back to a little power
it acts on the one you cut; falls back

skills.name: Tailwind
skills.summary: The longest dash, +3 pips, and the only one with no recovery: you can strike or cast the instant it ends.
skills.verb_fit: Carry is "be carried along, faster": the wind at your back, and nothing else.

good_modifiers.word: True Tailwind: faster, in a line nothing turns

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite, and it hits nothing to slow: falls back to a cost cut
a dash cannot be held, and it has no damage or wind-up: falls back to a cost cut
nothing lasts; falls back to a cost cut

skills.name: Downdraft
skills.summary: Point, 8 m, 4 m wide: 50, interrupts, pins enemies for 2 s, knocks their shots out of the air, and does +100 to anything Aloft.
skills.verb_fit: Drop is "slam down": the sky is brought down on one spot.

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: throws Aloft what it slams flat. Maths lets it act; it should not
a blast at a spot does not travel; falls back to a little power
it lands on a spot, not on you; falls back

skills.name: Updraft
skills.summary: Point, 8 m: enemies within 2.5 m are thrown Aloft for 1.2 s (+0.2 s a pip, up to 4) - helpless, and taking 25% more. Heavy ones lose poise instead.
skills.verb_fit: Lift is "raise aloft": exactly that, to everyone on the spot.

good_modifiers.word: Gusting Updraft: throws them up and out

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite, and it has no poise field: falls back to a cost cut
nothing to pierce; falls back
nothing travels; falls back

skills.name: Crosswind Veil
skills.summary: 5 s: enemy shots aimed at you curve away and miss, and your Slipstream does not drain. Blades still land.
skills.verb_fit: Buffer is "cushioning air": a layer of moving air around you that shots slide off.

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite, and it has no damage or speed: falls back to a cost cut
nothing to knock down; falls back
nothing to pierce; falls back

skills.name: Gale Lane
skills.summary: A lane 10 m long from your feet, 6 s. In it you move 40% faster and gain pips twice as fast; enemies are pushed down it.
skills.verb_fit: Blow is "moving air pushes": a lane of wind that pushes them one way and you the other.

good_modifiers.word: Fast Lane: a longer, quicker run

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: dead air in a wind lane. Maths lets it act (less reflux); the word is nonsense
a lane has no hit to slow anyone with; falls back to a cost cut
nothing to pierce; falls back

skills.name: Spindrift
skills.summary: Hold while you run: you keep full speed, and every 0.25 s the nearest enemy within 3 m takes 25 (with Lee if you are behind it). Costs 6 essence a second and 1 pip every half second; ends when the pips run out.
skills.verb_fit: Blow, loosely: the wind you make running is the blade. (Weak verb fit - see the report.)

bad_modifiers.why: a held channel lasts as long as you hold; nothing to stretch, falls back to a little power
its own opposite: dead air while you run. Maths lets it act (less reflux); the word is nonsense
it moves with you; no wind-up to shorten, falls back

skills.name: Dead Air
skills.summary: Spend every pip: a 4 m bubble of still air where you stand, lasting 1 s plus 1 s per pip spent. Enemy shots that enter it drop to the floor, your pips do not drain, and your wind reflux sheds while you stand in it. Step out and it ends. Cast from a standstill it is one breath long.
skills.verb_fit: Lull is "dead air; shots drop": both, and it is how a wind fighter pays - with the pips running earned - to stand still.

new_mechanics.name: pip_seconds (zone)
new_mechanics.definition: With spend_all_pips, the zone lasts its life plus this many seconds per pip spent.

new_mechanics.name: shed_standing
new_mechanics.definition: Inside the zone the caster's wind reflux sheds at the moving rate while standing.

new_mechanics.name: ends_if_left
new_mechanics.definition: The zone ends the moment the caster steps out of it.

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: wind in the dead air; and it hits nothing to shove: falls back to a cost cut
it deals no damage and has no speed; falls back to a cost cut
the point is not moving; falls back

skills.name: Headwind
skills.summary: A wall of wind in front of you, a 70-degree cone 6.5 m long: 20 damage, enemies in it are Slowed for 3 s, a charge or pounce in it stops dead, and you take 1 pip from each enemy caught (up to 4). The one wind skill that pays you for standing your ground.
skills.verb_fit: Stall is "stalled; slipstream stolen": you stall them, and their slipstream becomes yours.

new_mechanics.name: interrupts_moving
new_mechanics.definition: Interrupts only an attack that moves its user (a charge, a pounce, a leap).

new_mechanics.name: gain_pips_per_hit
new_mechanics.definition: Pips the caster gains for each enemy the skill hits, up to gain_pips_max.

good_modifiers.word: Pinning Headwind: Pinned, not just slowed
Commanding Headwind: interrupts every attack, not only charges

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: carried along by the wind you are blowing against them. Partly acts (reach); the word is nonsense
nothing on the skill lasts; falls back to a little power
it stops motion; no speed to raise, falls back

skills.name: Dust Devil
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a whirlwind 3 m across that drags enemies toward its middle and cuts them for 15 every half second. It drifts at walking pace the way you were running when you cast it, taking them along. Lasts 1.5 s, plus 1 s per pip spent (up to 4).
skills.verb_fit: Whirl is "spin together": it spins them and gathers them, and keeps them together as it goes.

new_mechanics.name: pull_per_s
new_mechanics.definition: A zone that drags enemies inside toward its centre at this speed.

new_mechanics.name: drift
new_mechanics.definition: The zone moves at drift_speed along the caster's movement direction at the cast (still if the caster was standing).

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: blowing apart what it gathers. Maths lets it act (reach, power); it should not
maths lets it through, but on a payload that repeats every tick, so nothing in it ever acts again it re-applies Aloft every tick, so nothing in it ever acts again: a permanent lock, not a modifier
nothing to pierce; falls back

skills.name: Blowout
skills.summary: Everything within 4.5 m is blown apart: 30 damage and thrown 2 m outward, and each one lands facing away from you for 1 s, so your next hit is from behind. Spends up to 4 pips: +0.5 m and +10 damage each. It also blows smoke and gas away and knocks shots in flight out of the ring.
skills.verb_fit: Disperse is "blow apart": the pack, the cloud and the volley, all scattered.

new_mechanics.name: turn_s (payload)
new_mechanics.definition: A hit payload that turns each target to face away from the caster for this long (Riptide Lash's turn, for any payload).

new_mechanics.name: clears_clouds
new_mechanics.definition: Ends enemy smoke, gas and cloud zones that overlap the burst.

good_modifiers.word: Scattering Lift: blown up and out, Aloft

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: pulls in what it blows apart. Maths lets it act; it should not
one burst; nothing lasts. Falls back to a little power
a burst from where you stand; no speed, falls back
